description: Remote MCP server for schema-drift and security monitoring across MCP servers and REST APIs, plus a public keyless scanner endpoint.

commands: claude mcp add --transport http apitella https://api.apitella.io/v1/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer <API key>"
claude mcp add --transport http apitella-scan https://api.apitella.io/v1/mcp/public

notes: https://api.apitella.io/v1/mcp requires an API key and exposes five account tools.
https://api.apitella.io/v1/mcp/public is unauthenticated and exposes the keyless scan tool.
